summary: Iteration 7 end-to-end validation: project_statuses catalog (color field), MultiFileUploader (multi-attribute + multi-upload), FileGalleryModal, and dynamic status colors on Projects list. 6/6 backend tests PASS and 100% of frontend critical checks PASS. All seed data cleaned up.

issues: Hero subtitle still says 'categorías de ingresos, egresos y métodos de pago' and doesn't mention the new estatus de proyectos catalog. Minor copy nit only — the green tip box does mention it.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend /api/settings/catalogs/project_statuses returns the 5 defaults with correct colors (in_progress=blue, started=indigo, paid=emerald, with_debt=amber, completed=slate). PUT round-trips the color field. Invalid catalog keys are rejected.

MultiFileUploader: hidden <input type='file' multiple data-testid='project-files-input'> is correctly rendered with the boolean `multiple` attribute (get_attribute returns '' meaning the attribute is present). set_input_files with 2 files uploads both sequentially and both thumbnails (project-files-item-<id>) appear in the grid. Project create persists file_ids[] and table renders the eye badge count.

FileGalleryModal (data-testid='file-gallery-modal') opens from the count badge (project-files-count-<projectId>), renders gallery-item-<fileId> per file, supports image previews via /api/files/<id>/download?auth=<token>, and close button (file-gallery-close) correctly unmounts the modal.

Dynamic status color propagation: changing in_progress->red in Settings and reloading /projects immediately re-renders 'En progreso' badges with classes 'bg-red-50 text-red-700 border-red-300'. COLOR_CLASS map in Projects.jsx (statically declared) ensures Tailwind JIT picks up the classes.
New project_statuses item shows up immediately in both the status filter bar (data-testid=filter-<value>) and the create-modal status <select>. Confirmed end-to-end.
Tooltip: project-name-<id> exposes the description via the native HTML title attribute when description is non-empty (verified).
MINOR cosmetic: Settings hero subtitle copy could mention 'estatus de proyectos' so users know it's editable from there.
Carry-over from prior iters: date inputs are still browser-native <input type='date'> rather than the shadcn calendar component.
seed_data_creation: Temporary 'TEST En revisión' (test_revision/purple) project_status — added, verified, then removed. Temporary 'TEST_ITER7_MULTI' project with 2 uploaded image files — created and deleted. in_progress color was flipped blue->red->blue (restored). NO production data left modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 7 selectors verified: catalog-project_statuses with per-row color dropdown catalog-project_statuses-color-<value> and add-form catalog-project_statuses-new-color. Projects.jsx exposes project-files-uploader, project-files-input (has multiple attr), project-files-pick, project-files-list, project-files-item-<id>, project-files-count-<projectId>; FileGalleryModal exposes file-gallery-modal, gallery-item-<fileId>, file-gallery-close. Project-status dropdown options are now data-driven from /api/settings/catalogs/project_statuses (so iter6 hard-coded enum assumption is gone). When playwright reads get_attribute('multiple'), '' is returned (truthy presence), only None means missing.
rca of the issue: N/A — all iteration-7 acceptance criteria met.
